scope: Development, not final method validation. Sole architectural change: actor memory is read from the latest legal history frame, independently of candidate robot actions. Current-track reference is reused unchanged.
sensor: 360-degree centre-ray human-body occlusion; no range cutoff or random dropout
association: Ideal association of previously visible actors; identity is not a numeric model input
primary: Success rate in unseen 10/20-person populations, equally weighted; 5-person SR is a robustness check
checkpoint_selection: Final fixed-budget checkpoint only; IL snapshot is diagnostic
allowed_revision: One mechanism-based change per version. No action, reward, scene or sensing change; all variants and final weights retained. No checkpoint selection on development results.
